decisions.reason: Changing the fiat on-ramp from Coinbase Commerce to Transak does not change the Brevo transactional email provider or transport behavior.
The provider change does not alter the $5 automatic referral commission or its payout mode.
Selecting Transak does not change email-based dashboard access, its eligible users, dashboard areas, or authentication method.
The fiat on-ramp provider choice does not affect whether public data APIs require authentication.
The provider switch does not change publication of prize-pool values through public APIs.
The Transak selection does not change SIWE authentication for crypto minting and transfer flows.
The fiat on-ramp provider has no effect on the approved badge catalog, badge names, or icon presentation.
Changing the fiat provider does not alter ticket allocation after a successful mint without a referral code.
The provider switch does not change ticket issuance for successful referral-code mints or either ticket cycle.
The Transak decision does not change the first-referral badge trigger.
